versions.changelog:
- Made the skill user-invocable (set user-invocable: true)
- Updated version to 1.1.3 in metadata

- Adds a new "Final polish" section recommending use of a humanizer skill to scrub AI-generated patterns after writing the post.
- Specifies to preserve the engineered hook during humanization for copywriting effectiveness.
- Updates `allowed-tools` to include AskUserQuestion.
- Bumps version to 1.1.2 in metadata.

- Compatibility updated: Now designed for Claude or similar AI agents (removed "Claude Code").
- Version incremented to 1.1.1.
- New "Style" section: Instructs to use unicode bold instead of regular bold for easier LinkedIn copy-pasting.
- No other content or workflow changes.

- Added evals/evals.json file for evaluation support.
- Updated SKILL.md: bumped version to 1.1.0, added Openclaw metadata (emoji, homepage).
- No changes to core ghostwriting workflow or logic.

- Initial release of the linkedin-ghostwriting skill.
- Enables high-conversion B2B LinkedIn post creation using a strategic, multi-phase workflow.
- Includes detailed interview, hook engineering, and structured post writing guidelines.
- Emphasizes quantified results, clear insights, actionable CTAs, and mobile-friendly formatting.
- Reference materials provided for hook frameworks and example posts.
